name: neon-spectrum
description: Scrolling spectrogram at high color saturation, log frequency axis.
author: ambient-streamer

parameters.name: saturation
parameters.label: Saturation
parameters.description: Colour intensity. Negative values invert the palette.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.label: Gain
parameters.description: How hard quiet detail is pushed into visible colour.

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.label: Hue rotation
parameters.description: Rotates the whole palette; the fastest way to restyle it.
